results.evidence: Redid at 390 and 1440 with headless Chrome. The /preview/arena views were all dumped as text and screenshots, and I grepped them. Signed-in pages carry no non-affiliation line, no 'just a practice' line and no privacy filler. Profile's privacy block is a real consent control, so it is not counted. Several hedge and disclaimer lines remain. Compass: 'Cutoffs are DU's published 2026 history, not a prediction; 2027 rules stay provisional ... Your subjects and score stay on this device; colleges ... saved to your account.' Rival: 'Your rival is a simulated benchmark, not a student or a CUET rank prediction.' Ask Mobi: 'A practice observation, not a diagnosis.' Progress: 'Fresh delayed checks provide concept evidence, not a causal score gain.' Weak chapters: 'read this as a description, not a verdict' and 'read it as a rough guide.' Public side, outside the stated scope: every public page footer says 'An independent CUET preparation platform, not affiliated with NTA, the University of Delhi or any official exam body.' The About page has an 'Independent, and clear about it' section with the same non-affiliation text, and /coming-soon repeats it. Numbers and denominators are otherwise concrete ('5,941', '7/10 correct', '18 of 22 other students', '2 sessions, too few to read much into'). No hype found.
results.problem: The non-affiliation line is on every public page, and several signed-in screens keep disclaimer-style sentences.
results.fix: Delete the non-affiliation footer sentence from MarketingFooter and the About 'Independent' block (keep it in Terms only). Delete the Compass privacy sentence and the Rival, Ask Mobi, Progress and Weak chapters caveats. If an honesty hedge must stay, fold it into the number, e.g. 'Likely 31 to 69% (24 answered)', which the page already does.

results.evidence: Pricing, Start menu (Practice side panel) and result are right. Pricing: 'There is no fixed set of mocks: each paper is built when you start it, from a live bank of 5,941 questions, questions you have not answered first. Pro covers as many as you take; on Free, each one uses practice credits.' The FAQ 'How many mocks do I get per subject?' opened with a real click after elementFromPoint hit the SUMMARY, at both sizes. It says 'With Pro there is no cap' and 'A subject with a small bank can bring back questions you have answered before'. Start menu: 'Every paper is built fresh from the 1,404 Accountancy questions in the bank ... There is no cap on how many you take, only the practice credits each one uses.' Result (bottom of page, small text under 'Take another fresh paper'): 'built new from the 1,404 questions in the bank ... no cap on how many papers you take.' The landing hero has one calm sentence, 'drawn fresh from one bank of 5,941 questions across 15 subjects, so it never runs out at 10 or 30 mocks'. There is no banner anywhere and no 'never repeats'. Onboarding is the weak one: 'Each mock in a subject is a fresh paper from its question bank.' It does not say the bank is live or that there is no cap.
results.problem: Onboarding says 'fresh paper' only. It never mentions one live bank or the absence of a cap.
results.fix: Change ONBOARDING_LEAD in src/lib/paperCopy.mjs to: 'Pick up to 5. Every mock is built fresh from one live question bank, with no cap on how many you take. You can change them any time.' The landing line 'never runs out at 10 or 30 mocks' also names rivals' numbers; consider 'so there is no fixed set to run out of'.

results.evidence: Zero '41 subjects': grep of src and public found none. Fetching 22 public pages from the dev server, including the sitemap, found only '$41' RSC flight references and a '2:41' timer in a sample. The 390 and 1440 text dumps of 22 signed-in views and 20 public pages found none either. The claim reads right in two places. Pricing shows 'Full NTA-pattern mocks for the 15 subjects behind 19 of every 20 CUET papers (2026 NTA data).' The home meta description, og:description and twitter:description use the same sentence without the source tag. The 4 dropped subjects are hidden: /api/subjects returns 38 entries and none is Entrepreneurship, Teaching Aptitude, Legal Studies or Engineering Graphics (the route uses withoutRetiredSubjects). The onboarding and dashboard pickers show only the 15 with practice 'supported'. No retired name appears in any rendered page. Gap: the landing's visible hero says only 'across 15 subjects' and never the '19 of every 20 papers' claim, while the footer and features copy say 'Built first for English, Accountancy, Business Studies and Economics', which reads as a different claim.
results.problem: The visible landing claim is not the owner's sentence; it appears only on Pricing and in meta tags.
results.fix: Put SUBJECT_CLAIM.long into the landing hero in place of 'across 15 subjects', or into the closing section above the footer.

results.evidence: Every time rendered in the captures is 12-hour with am/pm and relative where natural. Review (390 and 1440, Day and Night): 'Quick practice, yesterday, 4:43 PM' and 'Quick practice, 14 Oct, 4:43 PM'. Result: 'Accountancy full mock. Recorded 3:21 PM, 46m 36s.' Landing Mobi caption: 'Even at 11pm.' A code search for time formatters found hour12: true or en-IN/en-US defaults everywhere (Mob model, account model, RepairEnding, admin and moderation). No 24-hour clock string is rendered; '23:00' and '18:00' appear only in API validation error messages. Minor: src/app/(app)/recovery/page.jsx line 58 prints 'Next fresh check: ' plus toLocaleString('en-IN') plus ' IST', which gives '17/10/2026, 8:41:00 pm IST'. That is 12-hour, but includes seconds, is not relative, and I could not see it live because Recovery shows 'Recovery steps open soon' here.
results.problem: Only the Recovery next-check line shows seconds and a numeric date.
results.fix: In recovery/page.jsx use the same relative formatter as Today or Review (for example 'tomorrow, 8:41 pm') and drop the seconds.

results.evidence: Pricing /pricing was captured at 390 and 1440, Day and Night, full page plus a top crop. Typography is strong: the H1 is 76px Bricolage 800 on desktop and 41px on phone, the price is 56px, there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals clientWidth), the Pro card is clearly emphasised, and the Free card has a 'How Free works' note on desktop. There are no fake reference prices, countdowns or loss threats, and the credits are real (10 and 50 practice credits, 10 and 50 AI credits a month). The 15 Oct to now diff on the pricing CSS is mostly font-size bumps plus the Free note, so the upgrade is modest. The plan is not presented as 99 a month. The local dev server and live www.mockmob.in both render '₹99 gets you in.', 'Pro access ₹99 once', 'through 31 July 2027, with no renewal', and the FAQ 'Is Pro a monthly subscription? Not yet.' The code (publicOffer) switches to 'Pro is ₹99 a month' and renewal copy only when the monthly Razorpay plan env is set, which is deferred, so that state could not be viewed. At 390 the 'How Free works' note is hidden (its link has a 0x0 box), so mobile Free users never see the credit explanation.
results.problem: No per-month price or renewal is shown while the monthly plan id is unset. The visual upgrade is incremental, and the Free credit note is missing on phones.
results.fix: Show the owner's model in copy now: 'Pro is ₹99 a month' as the headline with a 'monthly billing opens soon' note, or set RAZORPAY_PLAN_ID_PRO_MONTHLY_99 once the Razorpay plan exists. Show 'How Free works' on phones as a collapsed details block under the Free card. If a bigger upgrade is wanted, give the Pro card a price row with the per-month, renewal and included-usage line items.

results.evidence: Code read in the worktree, not tested by running AI calls. The allowlist in src/services/ai/providerCore.js (ALLOWED_MODELS = openai gpt-6-luna and anthropic claude-haiku-5-5) is checked in callOnce before any client is touched. An env override such as AI_LUNA_MODEL is refused, not substituted. The database function reserve_runtime_ai refuses any other model ('runtime model not allowed'). Callers: Mistake Repair (luna, with haiku-5-5 fallback), Ask Mobi (replyDeps), moderation (LUNA_MODEL) and rival intro and outro (default luna). No other provider SDK call exists in src. The 'gemini' and 'gpt-5-nano' strings in data/ are offline labels and comments. Caps: STATUS.md says the paid cap was set to 0.0568 USD (Rs 5) by a one-off UPDATE on 17 Oct ~2:15 am, and the free cap is 0.0114 (Rs 1). I cannot read the database, so the live values are unverified. The migration file supabase/migrations/20261017120000_runtime_ai_user_cap.sql still seeds student_user_paid at 0.1136 (Rs 10), so a fresh apply gives Rs 10. src/app/api/ai/rival/start/route.js and submit/route.js call generateAIResponse without userId or userTier, so those two routes get no per-user cap. Moderation calls also have no user, which is by design.
results.problem: The per-user caps are not enforced on rival start and submit, and the repo migration disagrees with the Rs 5 owner decision.
results.fix: Pass ...spendUserFor(session.user) (userId plus a paid or free userTier) in both rival routes' generateAIResponse calls. Add a migration, or edit the seed, so student_user_paid is 0.0568 and a re-apply cannot restore Rs 10.

results.evidence: Signed-in nav is Today, Practice, Review, Explore, Saved, Progress, Weak chapters, Compass, Ask Mobi, Your Mob, Your standing, Contribute, My uploads, Account and Help. Near-duplicates seen in the text dumps: (1) the identical finding card 'Partnership Fundamentals is where the most marks are open' (30 marks) appears on Review, Weak chapters and Ask Mobi; (2) the 'This week, 3 of 4 study days' strip appears on both Today and Progress; (3) the 'Your next step: 10 questions, about 10 minutes. Start 10 practice questions' CTA repeats on Review, Progress, Weak chapters and Ask Mobi; (4) chapter-by-marks ranking exists on Weak chapters, Review and Compass ('Your practice says: Partnership Fundamentals'). On the plus side, the public Features page lists only 10 features, and existing ones were deepened (Review has a rule book and Revise, Result has a Mistake Lab).
results.problem: Several signed-in pages repeat the same record and finding instead of adding depth.
results.fix: Show the top-chapter finding card on one page only (Weak chapters) and link to it from Review and Ask Mobi. Keep the study-days strip only on Today and give Progress its own content, or drop the strip. Keep one 'next step' CTA per page cluster.
